paragraphs: I am a DevOps & Platform Engineer with 8+ years across enterprise IT and hosting. My work spans Kubernetes clusters, CI/CD automation, API gateways, observability stacks, and internal platforms that help development teams ship safely.

I designed and operate an integrated platform so development teams can deploy, expose APIs, monitor systems, search logs, and find tools from one place — without manual ops for every release. Project links on this site are UI previews with sample data.

highlights: Built and operate a 5-module production platform (Application Deployment, API Gateway, Infra Monitoring, Log Management, Application Catalog Hub) on MIR Cloud and Nutanix Kubernetes
Administer production Kubernetes on Nutanix VMs — RBAC, resource governance, Harbor registry, GitLab CI/CD, Trivy scanning, automated upgrades
Delivered OpenResty API gateway with Keycloak/JWT auth, rate limiting, draft→publish routing, Redis traffic control, and Kafka-based access logging

Built webhook-driven CD control plane for on-prem releases — reviewer gates, Docker/containerd on Kubernetes, systemd packages (.NET, Node/Nest, Python, SPAs), health checks, nginx/SSL edge; integrates with Jenkins/GitLab for build
Run Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK/OpenSearch for infrastructure and application monitoring, alerting, and incident response
Integrated HashiCorp Vault, Keycloak SSO, Trivy image scanning, and Linux hardening for regulated banking workloads
Operate Kafka, MongoDB, Redis, MinIO, and OpenSearch for platform services, gateway logs, and internal tooling
Use n8n and Conductor for operational workflows; Ansible and shell automation for repeatable infrastructure tasks
Primary production on MIR Cloud / on-premises Nutanix; deliver AWS and Azure solutions per project requirements
Managed Linux and Windows Server environments across development, staging, and production systems
Maintained infrastructure availability through monitoring, patch management, and performance optimization
Strengthened server security through firewall administration, access control, and system hardening
Automated administrative tasks using Bash, PowerShell, and scheduling tools
Supported CI/CD adoption and deployment standardization with development teams
Managed Linux and Windows hosting infrastructure including VPS, dedicated servers, DNS, and SSL/TLS
Automated server administration with Bash, Python, and PowerShell
Resolved customer and infrastructure issues through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting

projects.title: Application Deployment Platform
projects.description: On-prem teams often stitch CI, SSH scripts, and manual nginx edits — breaking audit and slowing production. This platform is a single CD control plane: register apps and servers, enforce reviewer gates, deploy multi-stack environments (Docker/containerd for Kubernetes, or systemd packages for .NET, Node/Nest, Python, and static SPAs), verify health, and manage edge nginx/SSL.
projects.benefit: Jenkins or GitLab builds the code. This tool deploys it to production — with approval steps, health checks, and nginx/SSL setup. Teams do not SSH into servers to release.
projects.comparison: Like Argo CD or GitLab Deploy (tools that push apps to production). Built for enterprise on-premises — Kubernetes containers, traditional systemd apps, and nginx edge config in one place.

projects.title: API Gateway Platform
projects.description: OpenResty edge gateway — single entry point for microservices with JWT auth, rate limiting, and traffic dashboard.
projects.benefit: All APIs go through one secure front door — with login checks, rate limits, and a traffic view for the team.
projects.comparison: Like Kong or AWS API Gateway — one entry point for microservices instead of many open endpoints.

projects.title: Infra Monitoring Platform
projects.description: Centralized infrastructure monitoring — host metrics, uptime probes, connectivity checks, incidents, and alerts.
projects.benefit: One dashboard shows if servers and services are up. Alerts go out before users report problems.
projects.comparison: Like Grafana + Prometheus or Datadog — monitoring and alerts for on-prem servers, without needing a cloud-only product.

projects.title: Log Management System
projects.description: Central log platform — Kafka ingestion, OpenSearch indexing, search, request traces, and IP block management.
projects.benefit: Search all gateway and app logs in one place — faster fixes and easier audit checks.
projects.comparison: Like ELK Stack or Splunk — collect logs in one system instead of checking each server by hand.

projects.title: Application Catalog Hub
projects.description: Developer portal — SSO login, application registry, health overview, and links to deployment, gateway, monitoring, and log tools.
projects.benefit: Developers log in once, see all apps and their health, and jump to deploy, gateway, monitor, or log tools.
projects.comparison: Like Backstage or an internal developer portal — one homepage for apps and platform tools.
